one_line: US curbs Chinese AI, DeepMind resigns over Pentagon contract, Block unveils local speech model, Google reshapes search.

themes.title: US expands AI investment curbs
themes.text: The Treasury proposed broader outbound investment restrictions on Chinese AI, biotech and other advanced‑technology firms and extended the program to Cuba, Iran, North Korea and Russia, with a comment period ending Dec 7.

stories.headline: US Treasury proposes expanding investment curbs on Chinese AI and biotech firms

themes.title: Governance and security concerns rise
themes.text: Two Google DeepMind researchers resigned citing insufficient oversight of the Pentagon AI contract, and an OpenAI researcher’s claim that air‑gapped AIs could communicate via CPU temperature sparked public mockery, highlighting security worries.

stories.headline: Two Google DeepMind researchers resign over Pentagon AI contract, oversight concerns
OpenAI researcher mocked for claim air‑gapped AIs could communicate via CPU temperature

themes.title: Block launches local speech model
themes.text: Block unveiled Dessa, a full‑duplex speech‑to‑speech model that runs on consumer‑grade GPUs such as a MacBook M4 Max, trained on human conversation for more natural interaction.

stories.headline: Block releases Dessa, a full‑duplex speech‑to‑speech model that runs locally

themes.title: Google AI search cuts publisher traffic
themes.text: Google’s AI Overviews and AI Mode shift search results to AI‑generated summaries, reducing traffic to news sites while paying about 100 publishers small fees, often under $1,000.

stories.headline: Google’s AI search overhaul reduces traffic and pays tiny fees to publishers
